chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
And he had consoled Ash‘ath ibn Qays regarding his son:
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say to console Ash‘ath ibn Qays about his son's death?
ai.summary: This narration highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) practical application of *sabr* (endurance) by personally consoling Ash‘ath ibn Qays, a prominent companion, upon the loss of his son. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Prophet’s and Imams’ active role in alleviating communal grief, transforming personal sorrow into an opportunity for spiritual fortification and divine recompense.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 291. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said
in condoling Ash‘ath ibn Qays about (the death of) his son:
